writeup.key_factor: Home team in form (points in 7 of its last 8, 4 wins in its last 6, 4-3 shootout win at Edmonton on Monday) against a Chicago team that is 0-4 on the road and has been outscored 44-26. Detroit is 6-1 in the last 7 meetings with Chicago. John Gibson is the probable starter for Detroit.
writeup.risk: Gibson is probable, not team-confirmed, and owns a .867 SV% this season against Spencer Knight (.897), who leads the NHL in high-danger saves; Tarasov (.940) is day-to-day and only the projected backup. Detroit is without Kasper and Appleton (IR to ~Nov 12), Edvinsson (IR) and Johansson (out). The price -166 sits outside the -150 band, so it only holds at -176 or better. The NHL Elo is the 2026-09-23 seed and includes no 2026-27 games.
